# third_party/

`AnnoSM_py/py_annotator/`: a Python version of [AnnoSM](https://github.com/YangHuaLab/AnnoSM)
(substituent-mode annotation of flavonoids, originally an R Shiny app). AnnoMASS uses it to
check substituent positions with the diagnostic fragment libraries `CFIL_extended.csv` and
`TPIL_extended.xlsx`. The installer copies it into `~/AnnoMASS/external/AnnoSM/`.
Please cite the AnnoSM paper when you use this check.
